protocol_dose_schedule_methods: In dose expansion, safety/tolerability and clinical activity of T-DXd at the RDE (5.4 or 6.4 mg/kg intravenous every 3 weeks) were assessed in five dose-expansion cohorts: post–T-DM1 HER2-positive (IHC 3+ or ISH+) breast cancer (part 2a); post-trastuzumab HER2-positive (IHC 3+ or IHC 2+/ISH+) gastric cancer (part 2b); HER2 low-expressing (IHC 1+ or 2+, ISH−) breast cancer (part 2c); other HER2-expressing (IHC ≥1+ or amplified by ISH or NGS) or HER2-mutant solid tumors (part 2d); and HER2-expressing (IHC 3+, 2+, 1+, and/or ISH+) advanced/unresectable or metastatic breast cancer for pharmacokinetic analysis (part 2e).

In patients with HER2-expressing non-breast and non-gastric or HER2-mutant solid tumors, the 6.4 mg/kg dose of T-DXd was administered once every 3 weeks until withdrawal of patient consent, PD, death, or loss to follow-up.
distinction: Protocol treatment schedule is not proof of dose administered to one author-labelled enrollee, whose treatment/dropout status remains case-unlinked.
